summit-climbing.name: Summit Climbing
summit-climbing.description: A marketing website for a small climbing gym: classes, pricing, membership signup, and day-pass booking.
summit-climbing.summary: A fluid marketing site for a small climbing gym covering classes, pricing, memberships and day-pass booking.

items.name: Home
items.description: Fluid responsive layout with collapsing nav (hamburger below 768px). Hero with headline 'Climb something new today', subcopy about a 40-route bouldering and rope gym, and two buttons: 'Book a day pass' and 'See memberships'. Today's hours strip (Mon-Fri 6am-10pm, Sat-Sun 8am-8pm, with an 'Open now' badge). 'Why us' grid of 4 cards: route resets every week, beginner-friendly staff, 15m lead wall, community nights. Testimonial quote, and a closing call-to-action band with a day-pass button. Footer with address, hours and links.

items.name: The Gym
items.description: Page header with intro. Walls section as a card grid: Boulder Cave (22 problems, V0-V8), Lead Wall (15m, 18 routes, 5.6-5.13), Top-Rope Tower, Kids Zone. Facilities list with icons: training board, hangboard area, yoga loft, showers and lockers, cafe, gear rental. Coaches row of 4 profile cards with name, specialty and years of experience (e.g. Maya Ortiz, head coach, 12 yrs). Stacks to one column on phones.

items.name: Classes
items.description: Filter bar with level chips (All, Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) and price chips (Under $20, $20-$35, $35+) that wrap on small screens. Responsive grid of class cards, each with title, level tag, duration, schedule, spots left and price: Intro to Bouldering $25, Belay Certification $35, Technique Tuesdays $18, Lead Climbing Clinic $45, Kids Climb Club $22, Yoga for Climbers $15. Each has a 'Book' button. Empty state message when no class matches.

items.name: Pricing
items.description: Toggle for monthly or annual billing. Plan comparison of Day Pass $22, 10-Visit Punch Card $190, Monthly Membership $79 (highlighted as most popular), and Annual $790, each with a feature checklist (gear rental, class discounts, guest passes, yoga access). Below, a feature comparison table that scrolls horizontally on phones, a day-pass booking form with date picker, climber count and 'Book day pass' button, and a short FAQ accordion.
